description: An issue in the WebKit component could allow an app to modify sensitive kernel state, leading to arbitrary code execution.
Heap buffer overflow in libwebp in Google Chrome prior to 116.0.5845.187 allowed a remote attacker to perform out-of-bounds memory write via a crafted HTML page.
Broken Access Control vulnerability in Confluence Data Center and Server allows an unauthenticated attacker to create unauthorized Confluence administrator accounts.
SQL injection vulnerability in the MOVEit Transfer web application that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to the database.
Apache ActiveMQ is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution allowing a remote attacker with network access to run arbitrary shell commands by manipulating serialized class types.
Microsoft Outlook Elevation of Privilege vulnerability allows an attacker to send a message containing an extended MAPI property with a UNC path to steal NTLM hashes.
A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in FortiOS SSL-VPN may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via crafted requests.
VMware Aria Operations for Networks contains a command injection vulnerability where a malicious actor with network access can execute arbitrary commands as root.
Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated access to specific API endpoints and personal data.
Remote command injection vulnerability in the Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands via crafted TAR archives.
